name: Dmarc Specialist
tagline: Reads your DMARC reports, sorts real failures from noise, and walks you to enforcement.
description: Email authentication is its entire remit. Hand it your DMARC report data and it tells a genuine authentication problem apart from a false alarm, then walks you through the path from monitoring to quarantine to reject without the usual guesswork.
author: brettev
notes: Native Grok Bot share. Third-party bot; not from xAI.
